decision.observation: 7 mph, gear 1, timer 06:29.282, two blue dots, no red icon. The car is still on the left grass with a slender pine trunk standing directly in front of its nose and the gravel road a few metres to its right, running up-right.
decision.hypothesis: The pine trunk ahead is a solid pin, so continuing straight would stall the car. The road is right of the car, so another W+D hold should swing the nose right, past the trunk and toward the gravel.
decision.memory: The grass verge here is dense with thin saplings — every one of them pins. Getting back onto the surface is the priority over keeping speed.
